title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Senior DevOps position focused on architectural strategy, platform engineering, reliability at scale, security integration, and team mentorship. Expected to lead technical decisions, design enterprise-grade infrastructure, and drive DevOps culture.

skills.rationale: Expert-level K8s including cluster design, operators, service mesh, and multi-cluster management
Multi-cloud or deep single-cloud expertise, well-architected frameworks, and cost optimization
Enterprise IaC strategy, custom modules, CI/CD integration, and policy-as-code
Enterprise CI/CD architecture, advanced deployment patterns, DORA metrics, and pipeline security
Deep systems knowledge including kernel tuning, security hardening, and performance optimization
Enterprise container strategy, supply chain security, and orchestration integration
Security architecture, compliance automation, zero trust, and threat modeling
Observability platform design, SLO/SLI frameworks, distributed tracing, and AIOps
Complex network architecture, service mesh, zero trust networking, and cloud networking
Advanced automation frameworks, CLI tool development, and Golang for cloud-native tools
Enterprise configuration management, dynamic inventory, and Ansible Tower/AWX
Enterprise GitOps architecture, fleet management, and progressive delivery
Git strategy design, monorepo management, and automation at scale

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.
